Name: Hybrid Crop Engine
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Hybrid Crop Engine [/b]lets content packs define hybrid crops, which have a chance of appearing between two fully-grown parent crops.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
[b][size=3]For players[/size][/b]
This mod does nothing on its own[/b], you need to install content packs for it.

You only need to install the mod and it'll work automatically for content packs that use it. If you have two fully-grown crops in the ground with an empty spot between them, there's a random chance each day a hybrid crop will start growing there.

See the optional downloads for an example Garsnips mod (a hybrid of garlic and parnsips).

[b][size=3]For mod authors[/size][/b]
Edit the [font=Courier New]Data/HybridCrops[/font] asset using Content Patcher or [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Modder_Guide/APIs/Content]SMAPI's content API[/url]. For example, using Content Patcher with Json Assets tokens:
[code]{
"Format": "1.24.0",
"Changes": [
{
"Action": "EditData",
"Target": "Data/HybridCrops",
"Entries": {
"{{spacechase0.JsonAssets/CropId:Garsnip}}": {
"BaseCropA": 0,
"BaseCropB": 4,
"Chance": 0.05,
}
}
}
]
}
[/code]

The key is the crop index for the hybrid crop in the [font=Courier New]TileSheets\crops[/font] spritesheet. The value is an object containing three fields:
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]BaseCropA[/font]: the index of the first parent crop.
[*][font=Courier New]BaseCropB[/font]: the index of the second parent crop.
[*][font=Courier New]Chance[/font]: a percentage chance of a hybrid appearing each day, as a value between 0 and 1 (e.g. 0.05 for 5%).
[/list]
[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
